calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.not_capable: This phone's Vibb One doesn't know Dagen yet
calendar.not_capable_sub: What you set here reaches it once Vibb One is updated.
calendar.summary.label: Calendar
calendar.dagen.title: Dagen
calendar.dagen.on_home_sub: Off hides the tile, the lock screen's line and the reminders; the rules stay
calendar.dagen.footer: Dagen is the kid's day in Vibb One: one day at a time, swiped from day to day. The kid's own events go to the chosen calendar; they can change or delete only those.
calendar.kid.label: The kid's events go to
calendar.lock.title: On the lock screen
calendar.lock.footer: What the lock screen shows, anyone near the phone can see: a title can name a place. A reminder is a row on the lock screen before the event - no sound, no vibration - and it follows the title rules. Off here means no reminder whatever a calendar below says.
calendar.calendars.title: Calendars shown
calendar.calendars.reminders_off: Reminders are off for this phone
calendar.calendars.footer: From the phone's last report. A reminder is chosen per calendar, here: off, the calendar's own reminders (at most two hours before), or a fixed number of minutes before every event.
calendar.calendars.no_report: The phone hasn't said which calendars it has yet. It does with its next report.
calendar.calendars.unreadable: The phone can't read its calendars. Vibb One needs the calendar permission, which it gives itself while the phone is managed.
calendar.calendars.none: The phone has no calendar yet.
calendar.calendars.setup: Add ICSx5 (feeds) or DAVx5 (CalDAV) from the catalog's F-Droid source, tick it for this phone, switch On Home off under Apps, then in a pause open it and add the feed or log in. Tip: send the webcal:// link to the kid in Element X and tap it in the pause. DAVx5: use an app password and read-only shares; sync every 1-4 hours saves battery.
calendar.rules.title: Title rules
calendar.rules.footer: First matching rule wins. The phone applies them when it draws the day; the calendar itself never leaves the phone.
calendar.rules.gone: That rule was deleted in the meantime.
calendar.rules.skipped: The phone's Vibb One can't use rule {ids} yet and leaves it out.
calendar.rule.title: Title rule
calendar.rule.field.title: The title
calendar.rule.match_footer: Capital letters and spaces don't matter: "Romerriket" also finds "R omerriket".
calendar.rule.keep_rest: Keep the rest of the title
calendar.rule.then_footer: Show as with Keep the rest: the text, then the title without what matched. Without it: the text alone. A rule on the description can only hide the event.
calendar.rule.delete_confirm: Delete this rule? The phone shows these events as the calendar has them.
calendar.rule.calendar_gone: A calendar no longer on the phone
calendar.rule.error.field: Pick the title or the description.
calendar.rule.error.pattern_empty: Type the text to look for.
calendar.rule.error.pattern_long: The text to look for is at most 120 characters.
calendar.rule.error.then: Pick Show as or Hide the event.
calendar.rule.error.description_hides: A rule on the description can only hide the event.
calendar.rule.error.text_empty: Type the text to show, or keep the rest of the title.
calendar.rule.error.text_long: The text to show is at most 40 characters.
calendar.rule.error.calendar: Pick one of the phone's calendars.
calendar.rule.error.too_many: This phone has 30 rules already - delete one first.
calendar.preview.title: Preview
calendar.preview.footer: Paste a real title to see what the phone will show. Only what you paste is checked: the phone's events never reach the server.
calendar.preview.no_match: No rule matches: the phone shows it as it is.
calendar.error.read: Couldn't read the calendar settings - check the server log.
calendar.error.save: Couldn't save - nothing was changed. Check the server log.
calendar.error.kid_calendar: Not a calendar the kid can add events to.
calendar.error.move: Move a rule up or down.
calendar.kid.gone: The chosen calendar - not on the phone now
apps.on_home_sub: Off: the app stays allowed and runs, but the kid doesn't see it on Home or in the app list, except during a pause - for a sync app such as ICSx5 or DAVx5.
error.csrf: Refused: this form was sent from another site.
account.title: Account & Parents
account.warning.live.one: {count} wrong two-factor code was entered since your last sign-in. Whoever entered them knows your password - change it now (that also lifts the lock).
account.warning.live.other: {count} wrong two-factor codes were entered since your last sign-in. Whoever entered them knows your password - change it now (that also lifts the lock).
account.warning.live_locked.one: {count} wrong two-factor code was entered since your last sign-in, and new sign-ins are locked until {until}. Whoever entered them knows your password - change it now (that also lifts the lock).
account.warning.live_locked.other: {count} wrong two-factor codes were entered since your last sign-in, and new sign-ins are locked until {until}. Whoever entered them knows your password - change it now (that also lifts the lock).
account.name.title: Name
account.name.label: Your name
account.name.hint: What the other parents see, like "Mamma". Empty: {username}.
account.name.bad_chars: Use letters, digits, spaces and punctuation only.
account.password.title: Password
account.password.footer: A new password signs out every other browser and phone and turns notifications off everywhere.
account.password.changed: Password changed. Every other browser and phone is signed out, and notifications are off everywhere.
account.password.too_short: Use at least 12 characters. Nothing was changed.
account.password.mismatch: The new passwords don't match. Nothing was changed.
account.password.wrong: The current password is wrong. Nothing was changed.
account.password.wrong_last: The current password is wrong. Nothing was changed. One more wrong one signs you out.
account.password.failed: Couldn't save the new password - nothing was changed. Check the server log.
account.totp.title: Two-Factor Login
account.totp.reset_confirm: For a lost authenticator app: you scan a new QR code next, every other browser and phone is signed out, and notifications are turned off everywhere.
account.totp.footer: Locked out and signed out? It can be reset on the server.
account.totp.server_info: How to reset two-factor login on the server
account.totp.server_password: It also puts a new password in data/initial-admin-password-{id}.
account.totp.wrong: The current password is wrong. Two-factor login was not reset.
account.totp.wrong_last: The current password is wrong. Two-factor login was not reset. One more wrong one signs you out.
account.totp.failed: Couldn't reset two-factor login - nothing was changed. Check the server log.
account.sessions.title: Sessions
account.sessions.sign_out_confirm: Sign out every browser and phone that has Vibb Phone open, this one too?
account.sessions.footer: For a lost phone or computer that is still signed in.
account.sessions.failed: Couldn't sign out the other sessions - nothing was changed. Check the server log.
account.language.title: Language
account.language.label: Vibb Phone in
account.language.footer: Your account's language. Every parent chooses their own.
account.language.refused: Not a language this server has.
account.parents.title: Parents
account.parents.footer: Every parent signs in with their own password and two-factor login, and manages every phone. Up to 8.
account.parents.new_otp_confirm: Make a new one-time password for {name}? The one they have stops working at once.
account.parents.reset_confirm: Reset {name}'s password and two-factor login? {name} is signed out everywhere and signs in again with a new one-time password from you.
account.parents.reset_yourself: Your own account: change your password or reset your two-factor login above.
account.parents.reset_failed: Couldn't reset the parent - nothing was changed. Check the server log.
account.parents.withdraw_confirm: Withdraw {name}'s invitation? The one-time password stops working at once. The username {username} stays taken.
account.parents.remove_confirm: Remove {name}? {name} is signed out everywhere and can't sign in again; what they did keeps their name. Only the server's reset-2fa brings the account back.
account.parents.removed: Done - that account can't sign in any more.
account.parents.last_you: You are the only parent who can sign in - add another parent first.
account.parents.last_other: {name} is the only parent who can sign in - add another parent first.
account.parents.remove_failed: Couldn't remove the parent - nothing was changed. Check the server log.
account.parents.one_more_wrong: One more wrong one signs you out.
account.add.username_hint: For signing in, like "pappa": lowercase letters, digits, . _ or -.
account.add.name: Their name
account.add.name_hint: What you all see, like "Pappa". They can change it.
account.add.password_hint: The one you sign in here with. You get a one-time password to give them; three wrong passwords sign you out.
account.add.username_rule: Use 1-32 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. No one was added.
account.add.taken: That username is taken. No one was added.
account.add.full: A family can have at most 8 parents. No one was added.
account.add.failed: Couldn't add the parent - no one was added. Check the server log.
account.otp.first: One-time password for {name} · sign in as {username}
account.otp.new: New one-time password for {name} · sign in as {username}
account.otp.hint: Copy it before you leave this page - it's shown only once. It works until {until}; {name} sets a new password and two-factor login at the first sign-in.
